verdict.rationale: RudderStack's compliance toolkit says it can block, mask, or encrypt PII before it goes downstream, and its Transformations feature filters and reshapes event data before it reaches destinations. Both are first-party capabilities, so this is the product's own support. However, per-destination scoping and hashing are not explicitly documented, and the evidence is only marketing-level. Missing for 10: explicit per-destination PII policy configuration, documented hashing support, in-depth docs on field-level filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes

citations.quote: Block, mask, or encrypt PII before it gets downstream, so every team can move fast with confidence.
Transformations let you filter, enrich, and reshape event data before it reaches your destinations.
